response.text:
Here are the deadlines falling in October 2026:

- **Library books – return overdue items**, due Fri 2 Oct 2026, to Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149] [party:pty_d2ymm5s3htd0]. If not returned, the letter says the fee keeps rising per item per opening day until your account is blocked.

- **Muster BKK – decide on an objection to the contribution notice**, due Wed 14 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg] [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3]. Note: contributions must still be paid at the assessed amount even if you object, since an objection has no suspensive effect.

- **Finanzamt Musterstadt – decide on an Einspruch against the tax assessment**, due Wed 21 Oct 2026, so it should be sent by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a] [party:pty_mcq97yavgqjy]. If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final.

- **FunkNetz Mobil (contract "FunkNetz Smart M") – cancellation deadline**: must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026, so send by Thu 8 Oct 2026; current term runs to Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2] [party:pty_gjsv4q2d3ajw].

- **Stadtwerke Musterstadt (contract "MusterStrom Flex") – special cancellation due to a price increase**: the new price takes effect Sun 1 Nov 2026, so to cancel before it applies it must arrive by Sat 31 Oct 2026 — send by Mon 26 Oct 2026 (safe date Fri 30 Oct 2026) [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5] [party:pty_fh8cf155ffm3].

You can review or act on each in Ordnung under the linked to-do or contract (e.g. "Draft letter" or "Mark done").
